span.p:
edit 2: mov dword [0x140441934], 0x27
opt_algo forced to 39 = sha256d.
It sits between a cmp and its jne, so
-a on the command line is ignored.

serial, cached at 0x140492b48

key = modified_sha256d(serial, 0x0B501E7E)[0:16]
written over the target buffer, so your -u
value cannot influence the key
